findings.description: One continuous72h generation per family writes the original generated truth/dataset, simulation orbit, clocks/ambiguities and evaluation/truth.npz. Public component worker forces retain_native_diagnostics=True, so compaction does not remove those files.

Prefix preparation passes the raw generation record with evaluation_inputs to verify_manifest. That routine reads/hashes evaluation truth for integrity. This is not an estimator likelihood or initializer read; therefore an absolute statement that only generation ever reads truth bytes would be inaccurate.

Observation masking precedes code-only bootstrap. Bootstrap reads retained code, transmitter SP3 and clock data; nominal closure fits six initial-state components to that bootstrap then closes fixed-state nominal physics. The fitting initial_state converts that prepared orbit and initializes force parameters to zero. No evaluation trajectory, true clocks or true ambiguities enters these calls.

Known noiseless nadir-pointing attitude is derived from truth position/velocity and explicitly included in estimation_inputs. It supplies antenna/spacecraft orientation to the native model. It is a declared synthetic observation assumption; truth-isolation claims must not imply that all estimation inputs are independent of truth.

Blind preparation allowlist excludes evaluation_inputs/truth/reference fields. Runtime request validation rejects their roles/paths; native_data_inventory pins exact prepared-data membership. Private fit data contain prepared GNSS/attitude/transmitter products and a copy of the GNSS-derived orbit; no planned copying of generation truth into fit data was found.

The outer namespace read-only-binds the run root parent then bind-mounts the entire run directory writable. Generation, prefix preparation and later fits are siblings under that run root and use the same runtime identity. The per-job lifecycle supervisor does not add a filesystem sandbox. Retained generation/evaluation paths therefore remain readable by a fit process if it explicitly opens them. Read-only mounts prevent mutation, not reading; inherited flight/reference trees likewise are not hidden by this mechanism.

recommended_claim: Truth trajectory/clock/ambiguity files are excluded from frozen estimation requests and estimator dataflow; known noiseless synthetic attitude is supplied. This is not an operating-system denial of access. Strict filesystem isolation would require a separately reviewed per-fit namespace/input export before claiming truth files are inaccessible.
scope: Read-only source/dataflow and configured namespace audit; no synthetic preparation, fit, negative-access probe or native work performed
